baseModel.note: Identical base and revision to run-1a; the dataset is the only experimental variable.

prompt.note: Identical to run-1a and to inference. The dataset is the only variable.

dataset.splitUnit: semantic scenario family; run-1a family assignments pinned via splits-run1a-pinned.json
dataset.targets: palette silence, prohibition of invented experience/preferences, multi-obligation MustState completeness

heldOut: run-1a unseen family (epistemic x superseded) — now a REGRESSION set, its composition class entered training
new held-out compositions authored before run-1b training (unseen/run1b-*)

gates.clr: strictly below run-1a on validation; target <=5%
gates.fidelity: >= run-1a on every check class; MustState omission = 0 on fixtures, validation, AND multi-obligation holdouts
gates.paletteContamination: the target of this run: strictly fewer fixture palette hits than run-1a's 3; validation palette-class failures below run-1a's
gates.inventedExperience: 0 tolerated on the no-invented-experience validation families and the epcot-pizza fixture
gates.naturalness: blind review vs run-1a and base; must not lose would-use rate to run-1a
gates.latencyVram: within 10% of run-1a through the same serving stack
gates.generalization: new pre-registered unseen families CLR <= 2x validation CLR
